title: CO Emission and Absorption-line Survey of the M87 Nucleus Using Archival ALMA Imaging
question: Is there molecular gas in the inner kpc of M87 (CO emission from the circumnuclear disk, ionized-gas filaments and dusty clouds, or CO absorption against the nucleus), as probed by archival ALMA imaging?

data.bands: Bands 3, 4, 6 and 7 (ALMA 12-m); ACA 7-m in Bands 3 and 6
data.arrays: ALMA 12-m (plus phased-array APP-mode .V data); ACA 7-m used only for continuum SED/light curve
data.angular_resolution: Mean synthesized beam FWHM ~0.03 arcsec to 2.3 arcsec across 12-m data; Xa1 CO(1-0) cube ~0.21 arcsec
data.sensitivity: Xa1 CO(1-0) cube: typical rms ~0.4 mJy/beam per 20 km/s channel; MFS rms per member OUS in Table 3

evidence.quote: We adopt a distance modulus $m-M = 31.11\pm0.08$ mag for M87 from surface brightness fluctuation methods corresponding to a luminosity distance $D_L \sim 16.7\pm0.6$ Mpc (cite: blakeslee09).

what.value: Systemic velocity v_sys = cz_obs = 1284 +/- 5 km/s with heliocentric z_obs = 0.004283 from stellar absorption-line fits

evidence.quote: from stellar absorption-line fits with a heliocentric $z_\mathrm{obs} = 0.004283$ (cite: cappellari11)
we assume a standard $\Lambda$CDM cosmology with $H_0 = 67.8$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$ along with $\Omega_\mathrm{m} = 0.308$ and $\Omega_\Lambda = 0.692$ (cite: planck2016)

what.value: CO(1-0)-to-H2 conversion factor alpha_CO = 3.1 Msun pc^-2 (K km/s)^-1

evidence.quote: For a standard CO(1$-$0)-to-H$_2$ conversion factor $\alpha_\mathrm{CO} = 3.1$ $M_\odot$ pc$^{-2}$ (K km s$^{-1}$)$^{-1}$ (cite: Sandstrom2013)

what.value: Dust-to-gas mass ratio ~0.015 adopted for the dust-mass limit

evidence.quote: For $T_\mathrm{dust} = 25$ K and a standard dust-to-gas mass ratio of $\sim$0.015 (cite: Sandstrom2013)

what.value: Previous SMA CO(2-1) tentative detection S_CO(2-1)dv ~ 8.8 +/- 2.2 (stat) +/- 1.8 (sys) Jy km/s in an ~80 pc aperture

evidence.quote: (cite: tan08) reported a tentative $S_\mathrm{CO(2-1)}\Delta v \approx 8.8\pm2.2(\mathrm{stat})\pm1.8(\mathrm{sys})$ Jy km s$^{-1}$ detection

what.value: Atomic-gas UV/optical absorption lines with v_LOS - v_sys ~ -131 +/- 19 km/s and FWHM <~ 300 km/s

evidence.quote: and moderate intrinsic FWHM $\lesssim 300$ km s$^{-1}$ (cite: tsvetanov99b; sabra03)

what.value: Total N_H ~ (2-5)e20 cm^-2 towards the nucleus from X-ray spectroscopy

evidence.quote: total $N_\mathrm{H} \sim (2-5)\times 10^{20}$ cm$^{-2}$ towards the M87 nucleus from X-ray spectroscopy (cite: wilson02; dimatteo03)

what.value: CO/H2 abundance ratios: 3.2e-4 standard (Galactic dense gas); ~2e-6 and ~8e-7 for diffuse Galactic sight lines

evidence.quote: A standard CO/H$_2$ abundance ratio of $3.2\times 10^{-4}$ (cite: sofia04; bolatto2013)
CO/H$_2$ abundances of $\sim$2$\times$10$^{-6}$ (cite: liszt19) to $\sim$8$\times$10$^{-7}$ (cite: pineda10)

recipe.method: Standard CASA pipeline calibration with the pipeline version appropriate to each data set; additional manual flagging; X20f re-calibrated after removing mis-flagged ozone channels; flux calibrator fluxdensity rescaled by up to 2% per spw for two projects; .V programs used in APP mode
key_parameters: setjy flux density rescaling of up to 2% for individual spws (2015.1.00030.S, 2016.1.00021.S)
Additional manual flagging for high antenna temperature, amplitude disagreement and poor bandpass calibration near spw edges
assumptions: APP-mode calibration adopted for the .V programs; no interferometric-mode phase self-calibration possible

recipe.method: Phase (and usually amplitude) self-calibration loops using gaincal with MFS Stokes I tclean images (Briggs weighting; some uniform/natural)
key_parameters: Final solution intervals per integration (per scan); resulting dynamic ranges from several hundred to ~9000

recipe.goal: Make continuum-dominated spectral cubes and peak continuum spectra
recipe.method: Image each spw (or set of overlapping spws) with tclean at native channel binning with a common restoring beam, then plot peak flux density per channel
key_parameters: Briggs robust r = 0.5 weighting, native channel binning

recipe.goal: Subtract continuum in the uv plane and image CO cubes
recipe.method: uvcontsub with fitorder = 1 with three line-channel exclusion cases, then image continuum-subtracted data at native and coarser (~20-40 km/s) binning
key_parameters: Case 1: exclude |v_LOS - v_sys| < 500 km/s (used for the main emission and absorption results)

recipe.goal: Build HST dust and Halpha maps and define integration regions
recipe.method: Subtract a Multi-Gaussian-Expansion stellar model fitted with GALFIT from WFC3 F475W and ACS F660N images, producing gas emission and dust absorption maps used to define CO integration regions
key_parameters: F475W from GO-14256 for dust; F660N polarized images from GO-12271 aligned and combined into a Stokes I image

recipe.goal: Search for CO(1-0) emission and set upper limits
recipe.method: Integrate CO(1-0) line profiles from the Xa1 cube (20 km/s channels) over HST-defined regions, a 0.5 arcsec CND aperture and a 0.2-0.5 arcsec annulus, with MC region-shifting noise; convert limits to M_H2 with alpha_CO
key_parameters: Integration velocity range: atomic-gas v_LOS range plus +/-100 km/s buffer; dust regions ~300 km/s centered on v_sys
200 MC iterations to build the noise spectrum

recipe.goal: Fit CO absorption lines in peak continuum spectra
recipe.method: Compute opacity tau_nu = -ln(T_nu/T_cont); fit each CO absorption feature with a Gaussian and linear continuum including Hanning smoothing; MC resampling for errors; weighted averages over data sets; Voronoi-binned refit of Xa1 across the central beam
key_parameters: MC resampling adding noise (std of line-free portions) to the best-fit model and shifting bin centers by a normal fraction (std = 1/4 channel width)
For CO(2-1) only the Xb APP-mode fit from 2016.1.01154.V is used among .V data
assumptions: Hanning smoothing incorporated to recover intrinsic line widths

recipe.goal: Derive excitation temperature and column density (LTE)
recipe.method: Solve the opacity-ratio equation for T_ex(2-1), then N_CO from CO(1-0) opacity and Q_rot; error bars from Monte Carlo draws of tau_CO; N_H2 from CO/H2 abundance ratios
key_parameters: 10^5 MC iterations with tau_CO drawn from normal distributions (std = 1-sigma uncertainty); 1-sigma and 3-sigma percentile ranges
assumptions: Single-zone LTE with adjacent transitions under the same conditions; beam filling factor ignored; CMB negligible; T_K = T_ex
Diffuse-gas CO/H2 abundance ratios (~2e-6 to ~8e-7) preferred over the standard 3.2e-4 for N_H2

recipe.goal: Non-LTE radiative transfer modelling of the absorber
recipe.method: RADEX uniform-sphere LVG models fitted to the weighted-average peak opacities of CO(1-0), CO(2-1) and CO(3-2) on a grid of n_H2 and T_bg for T_K = 10 K and 30 K
key_parameters: N_CO = 1e15 cm^-2 fixed from LTE; CO FWHM fixed to 10 km/s
Grid n_H2 = 1e2-1e5 cm^-3 and T_bg = 30-300 K; T_K = 10 K and 30 K tested
assumptions: Uniform, isothermal, homogeneous sphere with large-velocity-gradient escape probability; 12CO traces the whole cloud because tau << 1

recipe.goal: Limit circumnuclear thermal dust from the continuum
recipe.method: Fit the X2c2 uniform-weighted MFS image with a nuclear source plus an offset Gaussian for N2 (imfit); sample noise with random 0.05 arcsec apertures on the residual image; convert the 1-sigma limit to M_dust and gas mass with a modified blackbody
assumptions: Dust absorption coefficient at 850 micron (value not given) with beta = 2; T_dust = 25 K (or 100 K); dust-to-gas ratio ~0.015

recipe.goal: Measure ACA/ALMA continuum light curve and spectral index
recipe.method: Pipeline calibration and phase-only self-calibration of ACA data, MFS imaging, combine peak flux densities with SMA monitoring, fit mm/sub-mm spectral index; simulate DRW light curves to estimate non-contemporaneous index error
key_parameters: Intrinsic alpha = -0.6 for the mock light curves; Band 6 light curve 2 yr with one-day cadence

recipe.goal: Test telluric and bandpass origins of spurious spectral features
recipe.method: Model atmospheric transmission with am for each spw, compare ozone residuals with line catalogs, and compare peak spectra across spws and EBs to evaluate bandpass stability
key_parameters: Ozone lines tabulated down to CDMS/JPL log intensity -5.3
assumptions: N_O3 scales linearly with the depth of unsaturated O3 absorption lines

answer_key.quantity: H2 mass upper limit over the atomic-gas CND

evidence.quote: We find no evidence for CO emission in the central $\sim$kpc and place an upper limit of $M_\mathrm{H_2} < 2.3\times 10^5$ $M_\odot$ in the atomic gas CND region

answer_key.quantity: Nuclear CO(1-0) integrated flux (R<0.5 arcsec)

evidence.quote: we estimated nuclear $S_\mathrm{CO(1-0)} \Delta v < 0.109$ Jy km s$^{-1}$ (1$\sigma$ uncertainty)

answer_key.quantity: CO(1-0) integrated flux, outer jet region (highest S/N candidate)

evidence.quote: with an integrated $S_\mathrm{CO(1-0)}\Delta v \approx 1.19 \pm 0.36$ Jy km s$^{-1}$ that just exceeds the 3$\sigma$ threshold

answer_key.quantity: Global CO(1-0) flux over inner ~2 kpc

evidence.quote: returns only an $S_\mathrm{CO(1-0)}\Delta v < 4.8$ Jy km s$^{-1}$ 1$\sigma$ upper limit over the entire $\pm$500 km s$^{-1}$ range

answer_key.quantity: Global H2 mass upper limit (R = 2 kpc aperture)

evidence.quote: we find a similar $<$4$\times$10$^6$ $M_\odot$ global upper limit

answer_key.quantity: Weighted-average peak opacity tau_0 CO(1-0)

evidence.quote: we also constructed final weighted-average peak opacities $\overline{\tau}_\mathrm{0,CO(1-0)} = 0.00239\pm 0.00054$ and $\overline{\tau}_\mathrm{0,CO(2-1)} = 0.00390\pm 0.00063$

answer_key.quantity: Weighted-average peak opacity tau_0 CO(2-1)

evidence.quote: we also constructed final weighted-average peak opacities $\overline{\tau}_\mathrm{0,CO(1-0)} = 0.00239\pm 0.00054$ and $\overline{\tau}_\mathrm{0,CO(2-1)} = 0.00390\pm 0.00063$

answer_key.quantity: Integrated opacity tau_CO(1-0), weighted average

evidence.quote: The integrated opacity $\overline{\tau}_\mathrm{CO(1-0)} = 0.0281 \pm 0.0045$ km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Integrated opacity tau_CO(2-1), weighted average

evidence.quote: $\overline{\tau}_\mathrm{CO(2-1)} = 0.0410 \pm 0.0041$ km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Weighted-average absorber velocity offset v_LOS - v_sys (CO(1-0) and CO(2-1))

evidence.quote: the weighted-average $\overline{v}_\mathrm{LOS} - \ensuremath{v_\mathrm{sys}}= -77.21 \pm 0.44$ km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Weighted-average absorber line width sigma_LOS

evidence.quote: the observed $\overline{\sigma}_\mathrm{LOS} = 4.65\pm0.47$ km s$^{-1}$ is typical of disk-like clouds

answer_key.quantity: Velocity gradient of CO(1-0) absorption across the central beam

evidence.quote: shows the velocity gradient to be no more than 3 km s$^{-1}$ across $\sim$10 pc

answer_key.quantity: Excitation temperature T_ex(2-1) (median)

evidence.quote: we used the 15.9 to 84.1 (0.14 to 99.87) percentile levels of the $T^{21}_\mathrm{ex}$ distribution to find a median $T^{21}_\mathrm{ex} = 7.77^{+1.34}_{-1.94}\left(^{+14.88}_{-2.90}\right)$ K

answer_key.quantity: CO column density N_CO

evidence.quote: $N_\mathrm{CO}/10^{15}\,\mathrm{cm}\ensuremath{^{-2}}= 1.16^{+0.21}_{-0.28}\left(^{+3.55}_{-0.47}\right)$ with 1$\sigma$ (3$\sigma$) error bars

answer_key.quantity: Excitation temperature T_ex(3-2) (median)

evidence.quote: we find higher median $T^{32}_\mathrm{ex} = 28.6^{+26.7}_{-14.9}$ K with $N_\mathrm{CO} \sim 10^{16}$ cm$^{-2}$

answer_key.quantity: H2 column density range N_H2 (in 1e20)
RADEX best-fit n_H2 and T_bg for T_K = 10 K
answer_key.uncertainty: 1-sigma contours do not close; lower limits n_H2 > 1100 cm^-3 and T_bg > 45 K

evidence.quote: best-fitting $n_\mathrm{H_2} \sim 5100$ cm$^{-3}$ and $T_\mathrm{bg} \sim 62$ K
they provide $n_\mathrm{H_2} > 1100$ cm$^{-3}$ and $T_\mathrm{bg} > 45$ K lower limits

answer_key.quantity: Core and N2 integrated flux densities at 232.98 GHz (X2c2 imfit)

evidence.quote: flux densities of 1.220 Jy and 50.3 mJy, respectively, at 232.98 GHz

answer_key.quantity: Dust mass upper limit (T_dust = 25 K)

evidence.quote: this modified black body $M_\mathrm{dust} < 1.1\times 10^4$ $M_\odot$ would correspond to a total gas mass $M_\mathrm{gas} \lesssim 7.5\times10^5$ $M_\odot$

answer_key.quantity: mm/sub-mm spectral index alpha' from ACA data (program 2021.1.01398.S)

evidence.quote: we measured an apparent mm/sub-mm spectral index $\alpha^{\prime} = -0.60\pm0.07$

answer_key.quantity: mm/sub-mm spectral index alpha' from ALMA 12-m data (2012.1.00661.S and 2015.1.01352.S)

evidence.quote: result in a best-fit $\alpha^{\prime} = -0.47\pm0.11$

answer_key.quantity: Change in line-of-sight ozone column during a single EB

evidence.quote: suggest that either stratospheric or ground-layer $N_\mathrm{O_3}$ along the line of sight changed by up to $\sim$6% over just 30 min.

Briggs robust value for MFS maps, cell size, image size, niter/threshold, deconvolver and masks for tclean MFS and cube imaging
Which flux calibrator and which spws had setjy rescaling, and the exact rescale factors per spw
Self-calibration details: refant, solint sequence, number of loops, which EBs received amplitude self-cal
Exact line-free channel/spw selections used in uvcontsub for each project and spw, and how overlapping spws were handled
Pixel/polygon definitions, coordinates and positions of the HST-based integration regions in Table 1, and MGE/GALFIT component parameters and image alignment details
Frequency windows and error model for the Gaussian + linear-continuum fits of the absorption lines; exact Hanning-smoothing kernel treatment
Collision-rate files, line-width treatment and chi-square definition (data points, errors) used in the RADEX grid; grid spacing
Dust absorption coefficient kappa(850 micron) value used for the dust-mass limit
Rest frequencies used for CO transitions and source coordinates / phase centre
Exact channel ranges flagged manually in each member OUS
missing_for_reproduction: CASA and pipeline versions and per-EB self-calibration parameters
Imaging parameters (robust for MFS, cell and image size, thresholds, masks) and exact spw and channel selections
Region definitions for the HST-derived integration regions and MGE parameters
Exact fitting windows and Hanning treatment for the absorption-line fits, and the RADEX chi-square setup
Kappa value for the dust mass limit
score_reason: Data are public and the main results are numeric with clear equations and MC procedures, but many calibration, imaging and region-definition parameters are not stated and no code is released.
rediscovery_reason: Public archival data, a mostly complete recipe (uvcontsub, Gaussian opacity fits, LTE and RADEX equations) and numeric results (tau, N_CO, M_H2 limit) allow an independent attempt, though region definitions and imaging parameters must be re-derived.
